readings.title: Materials for the Dwelling Place
readings.subtitle: The Call for Voluntary Offerings
readings.text: [Exodus 25:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’el, that they take up a contribution for <dn>Me</dn>. From everyone whose heart moves him you shall take up <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> contribution.</dq> [3] <dq>“And this is the contribution which you take from them: <dn>את</dn> gold, and silver, and bronze,</dq> [4] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> blue, and purple, and scarlet material, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,</dq> [5] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> rams’ skins dyed red, and fine leather, and acacia wood,</dq> [6] <dq>oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,</dq> [7] <dq>shoham stones, and stones to be set in the shoulder garment and in the breastplate.</dq> [8] <dq>“And they shall make a Set-apart Place for <dn>Me</dn>, and <dn>I</dn> shall dwell in their midst.</dq> [9] <dq>“According to all that <dn>I</dn> show you – <dn>את</dn> the pattern of the Dwelling Place and <dn>את</dn> the pattern of all its furnishings – make it exactly so.”</dq>

readings.title: The Ark of the Covenant
readings.subtitle: The Throne of Presence and the Atonement Lid
readings.text: [Exodus 25:10] <dq>“And they shall make an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, and a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall overlay <dn>את</dn> it with clean gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it, and shall make on it a molding of gold all around.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners, two rings on one side, and two rings on the other side.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay <dn>את</dn> them with gold.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to lift <dn>את</dn> the ark by them.</dq> [15] <dq>“The poles are to be in the rings of the ark, they are not taken from it.</dq> [16] <dq>“And into the ark you shall put <dn>את</dn> the Witness which <dn>I</dn> give you.</dq> [17] <dq>“And you shall make a lid of atonement of clean gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall make two kerubim of gold, make them of beaten work at the two ends of the lid of atonement.</dq> [19] <dq>“And make one kerub at one end, and the other kerub at the other end. Make the kerubim from the lid of atonement, at its two ends.</dq> [20] <dq>“And the kerubim shall be spreading out their wings above, covering the lid of atonement with their wings, with their faces toward each other, the faces of the kerubim turned toward the lid of atonement.</dq> [21] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement on top of the ark, and put into the ark <dn>את</dn> the Witness which <dn>I</dn> give you.</dq> [22] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall meet with you there, and from above the lid of atonement, from between the two kerubim which are on the ark of the Witness, <dn>I</dn> shall speak to you <dn>את</dn> all that <dn>I</dn> command you concerning the children of Yisra’el.”</dq>

readings.title: The Table of Showbread
readings.subtitle: Provisions in the Set-Apart Place
readings.text: [Exodus 25:23] <dq>“And you shall make a table of acacia wood, two cubits long, and a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall overlay <dn>את</dn> it with clean gold, and shall make a molding of gold all around.</dq> [25] <dq>“And you shall make a rim of a handbreadth all around it, and shall make a molding of gold for the rim all around it.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put <dn>את</dn> the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.</dq> [27] <dq>“The rings are close to the rim, as holders for the poles to lift the table.</dq> [28] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the poles of acacia wood, and overlay <dn>את</dn> them with gold, and the table shall be lifted with them.</dq> [29] <dq>“And you shall make its dishes, and its ladles, and its jars, and its bowls for pouring. Make <dn>את</dn> them of clean gold.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall put the showbread on the table before <dn>Me</dn> continually.”</dq>

readings.title: The Golden Lampstand
readings.subtitle: The Menorah: Light of the Sanctuary
readings.text: [Exodus 25:31] <dq>“And you shall make a lampstand of clean gold – the lampstand is made of beaten work. Its base and its shaft, its cups, its ornamental knobs and flowers are from it.</dq> [32] <dq>“And six branches shall come out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.</dq> [33] <dq>“Three cups made like almond flowers on one branch, with ornamental knob and flower, and three cups made like almond flowers on the other branch, with ornamental knob and flower – so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.</dq> [34] <dq>“And on the lampstand itself four cups made like almond flowers, with its ornamental knobs and flowers.</dq> [35] <dq>“And there is a knob under the first two branches of the same, and a knob under the second two branches of the same, and a knob under the third two branches of the same, according to the six branches coming out of the lampstand.</dq> [36] <dq>“Their knobs and their branches are from it, all of it one beaten work of clean gold.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> seven lamps for it, and they shall light <dn>את</dn> its lamps to give light in front of it.</dq> [38] <dq>“And its snuffers and their trays are of clean gold.</dq> [39] <dq>“It is made of a talent of clean gold, with <dn>את</dn> all these utensils.</dq> [40] <dq>“And see that you make them according to the pattern which was shown <dn>את</dn> you on the mountain.”</dq>

readings.title: The Curtains of the Dwelling Place
readings.subtitle: Fine Linen and Goat Hair Coverings
readings.text: [Exodus 26:1] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place with ten curtains of fine woven linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet material, with kerubim, the work of a skilled workman you shall make <dn>את</dn> them.</dq> [2] <dq>“The length of each curtain is twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits, all the curtains having one measure.</dq> [3] <dq>“Five curtains are joined to each other, and five curtains are joined to each other.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the end curtain in one set, and do the same on the edge of the end curtain of the second set.</dq> [5] <dq>“Fifty loops you make on the one curtain, and fifty loops you make on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set, the loops being opposite to each other.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall make fifty hooks of gold, and join <dn>את</dn> the curtains together with the hooks, and the Dwelling Place shall be one.</dq> [7] <dq>“And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a tent over the Dwelling Place, you make <dn>את</dn> eleven curtains.</dq> [8] <dq>“The length of each curtain is thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits, one measure to the eleven curtains.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall join <dn>את</dn> five curtains by themselves, and <dn>את</dn> six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over <dn>את</dn> the sixth curtain at the front of the Tent.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outmost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which joins the second.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall make fifty hooks of bronze, and put <dn>את</dn> the hooks into the loops, and join <dn>את</dn> the tent together, and it shall be one.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the overlapping part of the rest of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [13] <dq>“And a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other side, of what remains of the length of the curtains of the tent, is to hang over the sides of the Dwelling Place, on this side and on that side, to cover <dn>את</dn> it.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall make a covering of rams’ skins dyed red for the tent, and a covering of fine leather above that.”</dq>

readings.title: The Framework and the Veil
readings.subtitle: Boards, Sockets, and the Separation of the Most Set-Apart Place
readings.text: [Exodus 26:15] <dq>“And for the Dwelling Place you shall make <dn>את</dn> the boards of acacia wood, standing up.</dq> [16] <dq>“Ten cubits is the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.</dq> [17] <dq>“Two tenons in each board for binding one to another. Do the same for all the boards of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the boards for the Dwelling Place, twenty boards for the south side.</dq> [19] <dq>“And make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.</dq> [20] <dq>“And for the second side of the Dwelling Place, on the north side, there are twenty boards,</dq> [21] <dq>and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under each of the boards.</dq> [22] <dq>“And for the far side of the Dwelling Place, westward, you make six boards.</dq> [23] <dq>“And you make two boards for the two back corners of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [24] <dq>“And they are double beneath, and similarly they are complete to the top, to the one ring. So it is for both of them, they are for the two corners.</dq> [25] <dq>“And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets: two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under the other board.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards on one side of the Dwelling Place,</dq> [27] <dq>and five bars for the boards on the other side of the Dwelling Place, and five bars for the boards of the side of the Dwelling Place, for the far side westward.</dq> [28] <dq>“And the middle bar shall go through the midst of the boards from end to end.</dq> [29] <dq>“And overlay <dn>את</dn> the boards with gold, and make <dn>את</dn> their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlay <dn>את</dn> the bars with gold.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall raise up <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place according to its pattern which you were shown on the mountain.</dq> [31] <dq>“And you shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, the work of a skilled workman, made with kerubim.</dq> [32] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> it on four columns of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks of gold, upon four sockets of silver.</dq> [33] <dq>“And you shall hang <dn>את</dn> the veil from the hooks, and shall bring <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness there, behind the veil. And the veil shall make a separation for you between the Set-apart Place and the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [34] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement upon the ark of the Witness in the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [35] <dq>“And you shall set <dn>את</dn> the table outside the veil, and <dn>את</dn> the lampstand across from the table on the side of the Dwelling Place toward the south, and put <dn>את</dn> the table on the north side.</dq> [36] <dq>“And you shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall make for the screen five columns of acacia, and overlay <dn>את</dn> them with gold, their hooks of gold, and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.”</dq>

readings.title: The Altar of Burnt Offering
readings.subtitle: The Bronze Altar for Sacrifice
readings.text: [Exodus 27:1] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide, the altar is square, and its height three cubits.</dq> [2] <dq>“And you shall make its horns on its four corners, the horns are of it. And you shall overlay <dn>את</dn> it with bronze.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall make its pots to take away its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its fire holders. Make all its utensils of bronze.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall make a grating for it, a network of bronze, and on the network you shall make four bronze rings at its four corners.</dq> [5] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> it under the rim of the altar beneath, that the network might be midway up the altar.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay <dn>את</dn> them with bronze.</dq> [7] <dq>“And <dn>את</dn> the poles shall be put in the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar to lift <dn>את</dn> it.</dq> [8] <dq>“Make <dn>את</dn> it hollow with boards. As it was shown <dn>את</dn> you on the mountain, so they are to make it.”</dq>

readings.title: The Courtyard
readings.subtitle: The Enclosure of the Dwelling Place
readings.text: [Exodus 27:9] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the courtyard of the Dwelling Place: for the south side there are hangings for the courtyard of fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long for one side,</dq> [10] <dq>with its twenty columns and their twenty sockets of bronze, the hooks of the columns and their bands of silver.</dq> [11] <dq>“And so for the north side in length: hangings one hundred cubits long, with its twenty columns and their twenty sockets of bronze, and the hooks of the columns and their bands of silver.</dq> [12] <dq>“And for the width of the courtyard on the west side: hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten columns and their ten sockets.</dq> [13] <dq>“And the width of the courtyard on the east side, eastward, fifty cubits.</dq> [14] <dq>“The hangings on one side are fifteen cubits, with their three columns and their three sockets.</dq> [15] <dq>“And on the other side hangings of fifteen cubits, with their three columns and their three sockets.</dq> [16] <dq>“And for the gate of the courtyard a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver, with their four columns and their four sockets.</dq> [17] <dq>“All the columns around the courtyard are to have bands of silver, their hooks of silver and their sockets of bronze.</dq> [18] <dq>“The length of the courtyard is one hundred cubits, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, of fine woven linen, and their sockets of bronze.</dq> [19] <dq>“All the utensils of the Dwelling Place for all its service, and all its pegs, and all the pegs of the courtyard, are of bronze.”</dq>

readings.title: The Oil for the Lamp
readings.subtitle: Perpetual Light
readings.text: [Exodus 27:20] <dq>“And you, you are to command <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’el to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.</dq> [21] <dq>“In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the Witness, Aharon and his sons are to tend <dn>את</dn> it from evening until morning before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – a law forever to their generations on behalf of the children of Yisra’el.”</dq>

readings.title: The Priestly Garments
readings.subtitle: Set-Apart Garments for Esteem and Comeliness
readings.text: [Exodus 28:1] <dq>“And you, bring near <dn>את</dn> Aharon your brother and <dn>את</dn> his sons with him, from among the children of Yisra’el, for serving as priest to <dn>Me</dn>: Aharon, Nadab and Abihu, El’azar and Ithamar, the sons of Aharon.</dq> [2] <dq>“And you shall make set-apart garments for Aharon your brother, for esteem and for comeliness.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you, speak to all the wise of heart, whom <dn>I</dn> have filled with a spirit of wisdom, that they make <dn>את</dn> the garments of Aharon, to set him apart, for him to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [4] <dq>“And these are the garments which they make: a breastplate, and a shoulder garment, and a robe, and an embroidered long shirt, a turban, and a girdle. And they shall make set-apart garments for Aharon your brother and his sons, for him to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>“And they shall take <dn>את</dn> the gold, and <dn>את</dn> the blue, and <dn>את</dn> the purple, and <dn>את</dn> the scarlet material, and <dn>את</dn> the fine linen.</dq> [6] <dq>“And they shall make <dn>את</dn> the shoulder garment of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet material, and of fine woven linen, the work of a skilled workman.</dq> [7] <dq>“It is to have two shoulder pieces joined at its two edges, and so it is joined together.</dq> [8] <dq>“And the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, which is on it, is of the same workmanship, made of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet material, and of fine woven linen.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> two shoham stones and engrave on them <dn>את</dn> the names of the sons of Yisra’el:</dq> [10] <dq>six of their names on one stone, and <dn>את</dn> the remaining six names on the other stone, according to their birth.</dq> [11] <dq>“With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you engrave <dn>את</dn> the two stones with the names of the sons of Yisra’el. You set them in settings of gold.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment as stones of remembrance for the sons of Yisra’el. And Aharon shall bear their names before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on his two shoulders for a remembrance.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall make settings of gold,</dq> [14] <dq>and two chains of clean gold like cords, of braided work you make them, and put <dn>את</dn> the braided chains on the settings.”</dq>

readings.title: The Breastplate of Judgment
readings.subtitle: The Urim and Tummim
readings.text: [Exodus 28:15] <dq>“And you shall make a breastplate of right-ruling, the work of a skilled workman, like the work of the shoulder garment you make <dn>את</dn> it: of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet material, and of fine woven linen you make it.</dq> [16] <dq>“It is square, doubled, a span its length, and a span its width.</dq> [17] <dq>“And you shall put settings of stones in it, four rows of stones: The first row is a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald.</dq> [18] <dq>“And the second row is a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond.</dq> [19] <dq>“And the third row is a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.</dq> [20] <dq>“And the fourth row is a beryl, and a shoham, and a jasper. They are set in gold settings.</dq> [21] <dq>“And the stones are according to the names of the sons of Yisra’el, twelve according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, each one with its own name, for the twelve tribes.</dq> [22] <dq>“And you shall make braided chains of corded work for the breastplate at the ends, of clean gold.</dq> [23] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold for the breastplate, and put <dn>את</dn> the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the two cords of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.</dq> [25] <dq>“And <dn>את</dn> the other two ends of the two cords you fasten to the two settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment in the front.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold, and put <dn>את</dn> them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which is on the inner side of the shoulder garment.</dq> [27] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold, and put <dn>את</dn> them on the two shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment, underneath and in front, at its joining above the embroidered band of the shoulder garment.</dq> [28] <dq>“And they bind <dn>את</dn> the breastplate by means of its rings to the rings of the shoulder garment with a blue cord, so that it is above the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, and that the breastplate does not come loose from the shoulder garment.</dq> [29] <dq>“And Aharon shall bear <dn>את</dn> the names of the sons of Yisra’el on the breastplate of right-ruling over his heart, when he goes into the Set-apart Place, for a remembrance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> continually.</dq> [30] <dq>“And into the breastplate of right-ruling you shall put <dn>את</dn> the Urim and <dn>את</dn> the Tummim, and they shall be on the heart of Aharon when he goes in before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And Aharon shall bear <dn>את</dn> the right-ruling of the children of Yisra’el on his heart before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> continually.”</dq>

readings.title: The Robe and Tunic
readings.subtitle: Holiness to YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Exodus 28:31] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the robe of the shoulder garment all of blue.</dq> [32] <dq>“And the opening for his head shall be in the middle of it, a woven binding all around its opening, like the opening of a coat of mail, so that it does not tear.</dq> [33] <dq>“And on its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet material, all around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:</dq> [34] <dq>“a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around.</dq> [35] <dq>“And it shall be on Aharon when he serves, and the sound of it shall be heard when he goes into the Set-apart Place before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and when he comes out, that he does not die.</dq> [36] <dq>“And you shall make a plate of clean gold and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet: SET-APART TO <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> it on a blue cord, and it shall be on the turban – it is to be on the front of the turban.</dq> [38] <dq>“And it shall be on the forehead of Aharon, and Aharon shall bear <dn>את</dn> the guilt of the set-apart gifts which the children of Yisra’el set apart in all their set-apart gifts. And it shall always be on his forehead, that they may be accepted before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [39] <dq>“And you shall weave the long shirt of fine linen, and shall make the turban of fine linen, and you shall make the girdle of woven work.</dq> [40] <dq>“And for Aharon’s sons you shall make long shirts. And you shall make girdles for them, and you shall make turbans for them, for esteem and for comeliness.</dq> [41] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> them on Aharon your brother and on his sons with him, and shall anoint <dn>את</dn> them, and ordain <dn>את</dn> them, and set <dn>את</dn> them apart, and they shall serve as priests to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [42] <dq>“And make linen trousers for them to cover their nakedness, reaching from the waist to the thighs.</dq> [43] <dq>“And they shall be on Aharon and on his sons when they come into the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near the altar to serve in the Set-apart Place, that they do not bear crookedness and die – a law forever to him and to his seed after him.”</dq>
